name: folio
description: A local-first Markdown reader. Static, no build step, deployable to GitHub Pages.

scripts.start: python3 -c "import http.server as s; H=s.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler; e=H.end_headers; H.end_headers=lambda self: (self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store'), e(self)); s.test(HandlerClass=H, port=8000)"
